sub: Google's November 2026 core update is rolling out to all sites and languages.

slides.title: What changed
slides.body:
Google released its November 2026 core update on Nov 10.
It applies worldwide and may take up to 2 weeks to finish rolling out.
slides.tip: Core updates are broad. They don't target any one site.

slides.title: Who it affects
slides.body:
Any business that gets customers from Google Search.
While it rolls out, rankings and traffic can move up and down from day to day.

slides.title: What to do this week
slides.body:
Hold off on big website changes until the rollout is done.
Then wait a full week and compare that week to the week before Nov 10 in Search Console.
slides.tip: Small dips usually need no action. Big, lasting drops deserve a closer look.

cta.sub: We'll help you read your Search Console numbers.
